When working in this repository or answering KotOR resource questions, follow
the repo-root `AGENTS.md`. Use the `kq` CLI; do not extract KEY/BIF/ERF/RIM/SAV/MOD/HAK
archives onto disk to search them: you must handle all of that within memory and/or the cache. `-i` is `--install`. Grep case-folding is
`--ignore-case`.
